text:
jamie: Getting a 403 when I try to open the Regional Model Overview (East). Need to triage a latency spike, can someone either share a shortlink that works for me or grant view access?
ana: ah — do you see the grafana sign-in page or the 403 error after sign-in?
jamie: 403 after sign-in. I can browse other dashboards but this one is blocked.
li: That dashboard is org-restricted (sensitive model metrics). We usually grant view to 'svc-obsv-readers' or the oncall role. I can add you but need the request recorded.
jamie: happy to file a ticket, just wanted a quick shortlink in case it's something funky.
maria: fyi we've been toggling a new panel in that dashboard — could be a stash in the folder perms. @li if you can add short-lived access that helps.
li: ok giving a 1-hour temp grant now. Shortlink: https://grafana.redwood/s/mdl-overview/east?view=shared
li: granting: `rbac grant --user jamie --role viewer --resource grafana:folder:models-east --ttl 3600`
devops-bot: ACCESS CHANGE: Temporary grant created for jamie on grafana:folder:models-east (expires in 1h). Ticket INC-2345 created to make it permanent if needed.
jamie: can confirm link works, thanks! pulling logs now.
jonathan: heads up — if you need traces too, it's a separate permission (loki/traces). Use this link to request it: https://infra.redwood/req?service=traces&user=jamie . Otherwise ping me and I can attach trace view to the same ticket.
maria: note for oncall records: we should check folder-level ACLs — someone recently moved the East model tiles into the internal folder. I'll add a quick postmortem note if that caused the 403.
li: filing a small follow-up PR to move the panel back to 'public-model-tiles' and will coordinate with product when we retire the internal copy.
jamie: great, thanks all. leaving logs + trace links in INC-2345 for the follow-up. :thumbsup:
